items.title: Now called Origin Plus
items.text: The app has a new name: Origin Plus. You will see it on the launcher, on the sign-in page, in Settings and on the screen saver.

items.title: The original Origin icon
items.text: The original Origin icon is back on the phone, the desktop and the TV home screen.

items.title: Gold and black
items.text: Buttons, highlights and focus rings are gold on a black page. If you picked your own accent colour in Settings, you keep it.
